from: August book, night 32 (In the Shadow of His Wings)
p1: King David wrote this song in the wilderness of Judah. It was a wide, dry land with very little water.
David was thirsty for the Lord, the way dry land needs water.
At night he sang, “I remember You on my bed. I think about You in the night.”
p2: Because the Lord had helped him, David sang a happy song. He sang, “In the shadow of Your wings I will be happy.” A mother bird spreads her wings over her babies to keep them safe. Jesus used this picture too. He wanted to gather His people like a hen gathers her chicks.
Tonight, lie still like a chick under soft wings. Tell Heavenly Father thank you for one good thing today.
old: One song-writer loved Heavenly Father so much that he thought about Him all the time — even when he was lying in bed at night.
“I think about You while I rest,” he sang. “My heart wants to be close to You, like a thirsty person wants a cool drink of water.”

When the world got quiet and still, he would remember all the good things Heavenly Father had done, and it made his heart feel happy and full. Bedtime is a wonderful time to think about Heavenly Father. As we snuggle down to sleep, we can remember His love and feel Him close, all through the peaceful night.
